about_the_game:
Devil Meat is a multi-ending roguelite adventure where you, a mercenary, are captured by the church and forced to take part in a fanatical saint's ascension ritual.

Strategically combine blessings to grow stronger, hunt as many demons as possible, and feed their flesh to the saint. In the end, nervously witness the eerie spectacle of her rebirth!

Gather Demon Flesh

To achieve ascension, countless unholy flesh is required. Slaughter the demons sleeping deep within the dungeon and devise strategies to explore more efficiently. The deeper you go, the more grotesque and valuable flesh awaits.

Help the Saint.

Veronica is a girl consumed by blind faith, waiting for your help to ascend to the heavens. Select and feed her as much demon flesh as possible. In return for your devotion, she will grant you powerful blessings.

Discover Multiple Endings.

When the ritual ends, you and the saint will face multiple possible endings. Will her ascension succeed, or will she incur the wrath of the god?

Features

  • 22 different endings—and one true conclusion.

  • Each ending distorts your soul and grants game-altering abilities.

  • Explore over 15 dungeons filled with monsters that demand strategic combat.

  • Combine over 100 blessings from the Saint to build unique strategies—melee, ranged, defense-focused, and more.

  • Choose from 6+ distinct classes, each with their own playstyle.

  • Encounter bizarre yet charming NPCs: the Saint, a parrot, an apple tree, and more.

Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 or later
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-3240 (2 * 3400); AMD FX-4300 (4 * 3800)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 560 Ti (1024 VRAM); Radeon HD 7750 (1024 VRAM)

short_description: Feed demon flesh to the fanatical saint and guide her to ascension. 『Devil Meat』 is a multi-ending roguelite adventure that demands efficient hunting and growth strategies. What she will become—and whether you will survive—is entirely up to you.
supported_languages: English, Korean, Simplified Chinese, French, German, Spanish - Spain, Japanese, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian
